name: Verifone Mobile: one handheld for the whole floor
object: Verifone Mobile, Shopify POS's new all-in-one handheld card reader for retail staff
audience: retail store owners and staff who check customers out on the sales floor and at a counter
message: This video tells retail store owners that Shopify's new Verifone Mobile handheld runs checkout, scanning and every payment type from one device, on the floor or docked at the counter.

moments.what: a presenter holding a phone up to the camera, standing by a tabletop POS stand, tells retail owners they'll want to hear this
moments.copy: if you have a retail store, you're going to want to hear this

moments.what: the presenter reveals the new handheld reader, says Shopify and Verifone teamed up, and that it now runs on Shopify POS
moments.copy: Shopify and Verifone just teamed up; this is the Verifone Mobile and now it runs on Shopify POS

moments.what: close-ups of the handheld's screen walk through search, cart and checkout, its built-in barcode scanner, and the full set of payment options (tap, chip, swipe, mobile wallet), then show a sale processing and completing on screen
moments.copy: it has a built-in barcode scanner, all the payment options your customers expect, mobile wallets built in too

moments.what: the device is shown two ways: carried anywhere in the store, including the fitting room, and then docked at the counter for a customer-facing checkout
moments.copy: use the handheld anywhere in the store, or dock it at the counter for a customer-facing setup

moments.what: the presenter sums it up to camera and tells viewers to act now
moments.copy: one device does it all; pre-order it now

cta: the presenter tells viewers directly to pre-order the handheld now, after demonstrating it can replace both a roaming scanner and a fixed counter terminal
why: A single presenter walking through the device on camera, in a vertical format built for the feed, makes a hardware spec sheet feel like a quick personal recommendation rather than an ad. Showing the same device in two physical setups (roaming vs. docked) answers the real objection a multi-staff retailer would have before the direct pre-order push lands.
